description: Smoke verification for the local tiny-LLM scorer wrapper scaffold. Verifies the wrapper protocol (--dry-run-baseline mode), --provider command/ollama scaffolding, --model-manifest parameter enforcement, output parsing, and integration with the persistent scorer protocol.

candidate_export_fixtures.note_do_not_commit: Generated request JSONL files are content-bearing and must not be committed. They were written to /tmp/ for ephemeral use.

model_manifest.behavior_on_out_of_range: Rejects with fatal error unless --allow-out-of-range-model is set; reports in scorer_name and stderr

provider_scaffolding.command_provider: available (--provider command --command-template). Supports {prompt}, {prompt_file}, and stdin pass-through.
provider_scaffolding.ollama_provider: available (--provider ollama --model). Checks ollama list before running; does not pull models; fails closed. Invokes ollama run per request, so persistent runner mode does not by itself prove loaded-model latency.

ollama_provider.model_sizes_note: All installed models are 9B+ parameters. None satisfy the 200M–0.5B Phase 2 gate criterion. These models exceed the typing latency budget (p95 < 20 ms commit-time reranking) and should not be promoted as satisfying the Phase 2 gate.

verification: Dry-run baseline single-request mode: produces correct JSON response with scorer_name 'local-llm-dry-run-baseline'
Dry-run baseline persistent mode: 234 cases, 0 fallbacks
Candidate-export fixtures: candidate_validation.exercised=true, 233 cases validated, 0 violations
remaining_risks: No real 200M–0.5B model was benchmarked — only --dry-run-baseline mode was verified. Real model inference latency and output quality remain untested.
The --provider command path requires a separately installed inference binary (e.g., llama-cli). End-to-end verification depends on external tooling not present in this repository.
The --provider ollama path requires a 200M–0.5B model pre-installed via 'ollama pull'. No such model was present on this machine.

Output parser is strict (JSON or exact candidate match). Models that produce reasonable but slightly-different output (e.g., extra whitespace, partial output) will be rejected as fallbacks. This is by design but may require tuning.
Stderr from real model inference during persistent mode could fill the pipe buffer and block the process. The wrapper prints warnings to stderr conservatively.
Prompt template is a single hardcoded format. Future work may need configurable prompt templates per model.
conclusion: Local tiny-LLM scorer wrapper scaffold verified. The wrapper correctly implements the SLM Reranker protocol in dry-run-baseline mode through both single-request and persistent protocols. Candidate validation is exercised with 233/234 cases having candidate slots, and all pass (0 violations). The model manifest enforcement rejects out-of-range parameter counts unless explicitly overridden. The wrapper is ready for real model benchmarking when a suitable 200M–0.5B model becomes available.
